exposure: Late discharge (after 24 hours for vaginal delivery, 48 hours for cesarean)
Early discharge (before 24 hours for vaginal delivery, 48 hours for cesarean)
cohort: 14,460 women with uncomplicated pregnancies, deliveries, and newborns
finding: Early discharge after vaginal or cesarean delivery was not associated with increased readmission rates compared to late discharge.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was significantly higher in the readmitted women with early discharge.
